description: This file contains functions and constants for normalizing and parsing Docker image references, including handling of domains, tags, digests, and familiar names within the Docker registry context.

methods.name: ParseNormalizedNamed
methods.description: Parses a string into a normalized named reference, converting familiar names to fully qualified references.

methods.name: ParseDockerRef
methods.description: Normalizes a Docker image reference, handling tags and digests, returning a canonical or tagged reference.

methods.name: splitDockerDomain
methods.description: Splits a repository name into domain and remote name, applying default domain if none is found.

methods.name: familiarizeName
methods.description: Returns a shortened, familiar name for Docker UI, removing default domain and 'library/' prefix.

methods.name: TagNameOnly
methods.description: Adds default 'latest' tag to a reference if it only has a repository name.

methods.name: ParseAnyReference
methods.description: Parses a reference string as an identifier, digest, or familiar name.
